messages:
morgan (PMM): ok team — we need a tight narrative for the launch post + webinar. focus: making the latency vs cost tradeoff obvious to engineers. thinking 2 CTAs: a short post + a 45-min demo. who can draft headlines and a simple chart spec?

emily (content): headline draft: "Get predictable latency without breaking the token bank" or "Faster inference, smaller bill: real tradeoffs explained" — leaning toward the first. short sub: one-sentence summary of what users actually get.

sam (designer): visuals: I like a single canvas with 2 panels — left: scatter of latency (x) vs $/1k tokens (y), points sized by throughput; right: small flow showing routing: fastpath -> model-A, fallback -> cheap-quant model. will mock tonight.

lee (growth): for inbound, segmentation: SMB devs get "token savings" lead magnet, enterprise asks get SLA/rollout checklist. set up 2 lead forms in HubSpot and route via utm=fastpath / utm=econ. also A/B subject lines for the post.

devon (analytics): numbers to populate chart: p50 latencies we ran: model-A (fp16) 85ms, model-B (int8) 140ms, model-C (quantized) 230ms. $/1k tokens: model-A $0.09, model-B $0.05, model-C $0.02. throughput correlates: model-A high concurrency but higher cost. i can export a csv and a tiny viz.

emily (content): can we make the narrative 3 bullets? 1) what you trade (latency vs $), 2) how we help (routing + prefix cache + quant policies), 3) how to start (free credits + demo). short and scannable.

sam (designer): quick chart spec (Vega-lite pseudo):
```
{ "mark": "point", "encoding": { "x": {"field":"latency_ms","type":"quantitative"}, "y": {"field":"cost_per_1k","type":"quantitative"}, "size": {"field":"throughput"}, "color": {"field":"model_family"} }
```
will add tooltips: p50, p95, cost.

morgan (PMM): love it. Emily, can you own the short post copy? Sam -> make 2 wireframes: hero + embedded chart, and a mobile-friendly variant. Devon -> csv and a tiny table for the blog code snippet. Lee -> hubspot forms + routing rules draft. deadline: mock + copy by EOD tomorrow.

devon (analytics): CSV ready: `model,latency_ms,cost_per_1k,throughput` then rows for A/B/C. will drop in drive. also ran a sensitivity run for payload sizes — p50 jumps 20% at 2k tokens. worth calling out in FAQ.

emily (content): ok drafting now. quick social hooks: "How much latency would you pay for 3x cost savings?" and "Match performance to user intent — not your wallet." short versions for X/LinkedIn.

sam (designer): mock links: https://figma.com/s/redwood-econ-launch (will share invite). rough wireframe: hero headline, 2-col chart, 3-step how-it-works, CTA: schedule demo / try free.

lee (growth): routing notes: map utm=fastpath -> growth SDR queue; utm=econ -> inbound AE with cust profile. add a hidden field for model_interest. also add a question on the form: "Primary concern: latency / cost / security".

benchbot: perf-test: nightly-run-42 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/nightly/42/report.html — p50/p95 numbers match devon CSV within 3%.

morgan (PMM): perfect. Emily finish headline + 3 bullets; Sam wireframes; Devon export to drive; Lee setup forms. we will sync 30m tomorrow AM to review assets before scheduling post. thanks all :rocket:
